stories.title: India auto retail sales rise 25% in October
stories.summary: Indian automobile retail recorded its second-best October on record, with sales rising 25.05 percent over September to reach 31,72,466 units. While 51.65 percent of dealers surveyed by FADA expect further growth in November, 13.64 percent anticipate a decline. The festive calendar remains a primary variable.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki to build 12 automated driving test tracks in Telangana
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki is installing 12 automated driving licence test tracks in Telangana as part of its corporate social responsibility initiative. The facilities will use high-definition cameras and RFID sensors to enable computerised testing. The automaker has now established over 98 such tracks across India.

stories.title: Auto dealers flag high inventory as demand risk
stories.summary: Indian auto dealers report passenger vehicle inventory levels at 43 to 45 days, significantly exceeding the industry-recommended 21 days. Despite expectations of a post-festive sales uptick, dealers cite rising financing costs and elevated stock as potential drags on demand. The festive timing shift impacted recent registration figures.

stories.title: MSME Ministry and Samsung India partner for skill development
stories.summary: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises has partnered with Samsung India to launch a skill development initiative aimed at creating jobs for youth. The full details regarding the scope and implementation of the program are currently available only to subscribers of the source publication.

stories.title: Sugar trade body seeks 35% hike in minimum selling price
stories.summary: The All India Sugar Trade Association has requested a government increase in the minimum selling price of sugar to 42 rupees per kilogram from 31 rupees. The body continues to support current cane prices as fair, while a government committee reviews grievances from sugarcane farmers.

stories.title: Centre advances tax devolution to states
stories.summary: The central government released 1.09 trillion rupees in tax devolution to states on November 5, five days ahead of the scheduled date. The ministry stated the advance aims to help states accelerate capital spending and meet welfare expenditure requirements in time for the festive season.

stories.title: Oil companies receive bids for 1.93 billion litres of ethanol
stories.summary: Oil marketing companies have received bids for 1.93 billion litres of ethanol for the 2026-27 blending season. Maize is expected to provide 59 percent of the supply, with surplus foodgrains contributing 0.69 billion litres. The volume suggests no shortage of feedstock for the 20 percent blending target.

stories.title: MSME Ministry signs MoU with TRIFED for artisan market access
stories.summary: The Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Tribal Cooperative Marketing Development Federation of India. The agreement aims to improve market access for tribal artisans registered under the PM Vishwakarma Scheme through coordinated support and infrastructure.

stories.title: Rajasthan mobile veterinary scheme treats 6.8 million animals
stories.summary: Rajasthan's mobile veterinary scheme has provided free treatment to over 6.8 million livestock animals since its launch in February 2024. State minister Joraram Kumawat reported that 98 percent of beneficiaries rated the doorstep services as good during a recent review of the department's progress.

stories.title: Reviewing the impact of demonetisation on tax base
stories.summary: Data from the decade following the 2016 demonetisation shows a tripling of direct-tax collections and a doubling of return filers. However, the expansion coincided with the introduction of GST and improved enforcement measures. Attributing the growth to a single policy remains a subject of ongoing analysis.

stories.title: Supreme Court clarifies state powers on pre-GST tax
stories.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that states may impose additional levies calculated as a percentage of sales tax payable by a dealer. The judgment addressed a 27-year-old dispute predating the Goods and Services Tax. The court confirmed existing powers rather than creating new tax liabilities for businesses.

stories.title: Sensex eyes strongest pre-Diwali rally in 35 years
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty have rallied over 8 percent in six trading sessions. The indices are on track for their strongest seven-day pre-Diwali performance since the inception of Muhurat trading in 1992. The market recovery follows a period of significant selling pressure earlier this year.

stories.title: Sensex jumps 2,009 points as Nifty hits three-month high
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex rose 2,009 points on Thursday, while the Nifty reached a three-month high. Investors cited falling crude oil prices and the outcome of US midterm elections as primary drivers. Buying was recorded across multiple sectors as the market extended its recent winning streak.

stories.title: Sensex and Nifty extend gains
stories.summary: Benchmark indices continued to rise on Friday, with the Sensex gaining over 600 points. While Mahindra and Mahindra led gains, Asian Paints and Bajaj Finance saw declines. The indices have risen up to 7 percent over the past five days, defying broader market volatility.

stories.title: Sensex recovers 6,000 points in six sessions
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex has advanced 6,064 points over six sessions, marking a sharp recovery from the selling pressure seen in August and September. Falling crude oil prices, foreign inflows and corporate earnings have supported the rally. The market is currently positioned for the upcoming Diwali period.

stories.summary: The Sensex rose 2,009 points and the Nifty added 576 points on Thursday, marking a sixth consecutive session of gains. Markets responded to falling crude oil prices and US midterm election results. The Nifty closed at its highest level in three months.

stories.title: DLF to invest 3,750 crore in IREO joint venture
stories.summary: DLF Limited and Everstone Group signed a term sheet to form a joint venture for investing in IREO Private Limited. DLF plans to invest 3,750 crore for a majority stake. The venture aims to acquire at least 20 percent of IREO India companies by 2027.

stories.title: Aditya Infotech to acquire 30 percent stake in KGraph AI
stories.summary: Aditya Infotech, owner of the CP PLUS brand, will invest 45.4 crore for a 30 percent stake in KGraph AI Solutions. The deal values the company at approximately 151 crore. The investment is intended to advance surveillance technology and next-generation products.

stories.title: Adani Ports to acquire Dutch operator Evos
stories.summary: Adani Ports and Special Zone Ltd will acquire Netherlands-based Evos BV for an enterprise value of 2.56 billion euro. The all-cash deal adds eight European terminals to the company's portfolio. This marks the firm's fifth international acquisition in five years.

stories.title: Pajson Agro India to acquire Pacific Global FZCO
stories.summary: Pajson Agro India will acquire Dubai-based Pacific Global FZCO for 354.52 crore through a share swap. The deal includes an installed processing capacity of 60,000 tonnes of raw cashew nuts per annum. The transaction will be settled via a preferential issue of equity shares.

stories.title: Nykaa acquires majority stake in Simply Nam
stories.summary: FSN E-Commerce Ventures, the parent company of Nykaa, has acquired an 82 percent stake in makeup brand Simply Nam for 33 crore in cash. The brand reported 16.99 crore in turnover for the 2026 fiscal year. Simply Nam will join the House of Nykaa portfolio.

stories.title: Titan reports profit growth in second quarter
stories.summary: Titan reported a 113 percent year-on-year jump in consolidated net profit to 2,393 crore, aided by a 671 crore one-time gain. Excluding this, profit rose 54 percent. The company cited resilient demand for diamond-studded jewellery as a primary driver for the performance.

stories.title: Aadhar Housing Finance profit rises 15.7 percent
stories.summary: Aadhar Housing Finance reported a net profit of 308.3 crore for the second quarter, up from 266.4 crore in the year-ago period. Total income rose 16.8 percent to 1,048 crore. Interest income from loans accounted for 897.9 crore of the quarterly total.

stories.title: ONGC net profit declines in second quarter
stories.summary: State-owned ONGC reported a 9.1 percent sequential decline in net profit to 15,489 crore. Revenue fell 5.6 percent to 43,875 crore, while EBITDA margins contracted to 57 percent. The results missed analyst estimates for both profit and revenue.

stories.title: Britannia Industries profit rises 10 percent
stories.summary: Britannia Industries reported a 10.1 percent year-on-year increase in net profit to 721 crore. Revenue rose 15.6 percent to 5,598 crore, driven by 13 percent volume growth. EBITDA margins contracted to 18.2 percent, missing the forecast of 18.7 percent.

stories.title: Bharti Airtel reports 31 percent profit growth
stories.summary: Bharti Airtel reported a 30.87 percent annual jump in consolidated net profit to ₹8,888 crore for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Consolidated revenue from operations rose 16.7 percent to ₹60,877.5 crore. The company reported an average revenue per user of ₹271.

stories.title: LIC reports 20 percent profit increase
stories.summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India reported a 20.12 percent year-on-year rise in net profit to ₹12,076 crore for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Net premium income grew 16.2 percent to ₹1.47 trillion, while net investment income increased nearly 2.5 percent to ₹1.15 trillion.

research.title: Could It Have Fit Anything? Restrictiveness of Economic Models, LLMs, and AI Workflows
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: How much does a prediction procedure rule out when its model class is unspecified? We extend restrictiveness from economic models to black-box procedures by measuring how well they approximate simulated prediction rules satisfying specified economic restrictions. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: How does cross-border ownership shape the lithium supply chain? Using global data on mines and refineries, I estimate a model in which ownership can lower refiners' effective ore costs, encourage mines to restrict spot sales, and. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Did a feedback mechanism between propositional and prescriptive knowledge create modern growth?
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Joel Mokyr has argued that self-sustained modern growth originated from a feedback loop between propositional (theoretical) and prescriptive (applied) knowledge that turned positive during the eighteenth century "Industrial Enlightenment". This paper presents the first quantitative test. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Policymakers who set prices for public infrastructure often anticipate an equity-efficiency trade-off: while higher prices could increase revenues from fee-paying users, helping to offset costs, they may reduce take-up among the poor. But this trade-off is. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Human Responses to Algorithmic Correction: Evidence from Centre Court
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study how algorithmic review changes error composition using Hawk-Eye records from professional tennis. Within 20 mm of the line, mistaken "in" call rates increase by 8.6 percentage points, while mistaken "out" call rates decrease by. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Information Games: Strategic Crowding and Firm Repositioning in Language-Model Space
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: When firms respond to new market opportunities, their capacity choices alter the future discounted free cash flows available to both competitors and investors. In competitive markets, these investment decisions publicized in news articles and analyst reports. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Risk Ceilings and Development Deadlines: Pacing AI under Uncertain Safety Productivity
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Can a regulator promise both a risk ceiling and a development deadline when safety productivity is unknown? A ceiling below the final model's unprotected hazard requires a minimum stock of safety knowledge, so both promises hold. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Safety Research and the Allocation of Frontier Compute
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: During a frontier takeoff period, an AI lab splits a committed stock of compute among capability research, safety research, and customers, and a regulator limits both the services customers lose and how long any capability can. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
